memory.content: The owner's Gmail end-state is Inbox holding roughly the last 90 days. Mail older than that should be archived off Inbox (kept in All Mail), except starred stays in Inbox, and newsletters/unsolicited promos go to Trash.
Gmail label Expert Witness is the archive for expert-witness and law-firm mail. Exclude legal-news newsletter feeds from that label unless the owner says otherwise.

Gmail label Expert Witness/Marketing holds availability-outreach pitches and counsel replies. File those into Marketing plus parent Expert Witness, then archive off Inbox unless starred. Active-engagement check-ins stay under Expert Witness only, not Marketing.
Gmail label Software Licenses holds software license and product-key emails.
Weekday Gmail checks at morning, mid-afternoon, and early evening in the owner's local timezone cover Expert Witness marketing filing and new counsel-reply notifications.

Standing authorization may allow bulk-trashing Inbox mail before a chosen cutoff date, except Expert Witness and Software Licenses labels; Personal and starred may be included when older than the cutoff if the owner confirms.

Gmail cleanup priorities: delete subscription and unsolicited promo emails; archive software licenses separately; archive expert-witness/law-firm mail under Expert Witness (off Inbox); recommend unsubscribes and further organization.
Gmail Personal archive uses an existing Personal label for family/friends mail; file conservatively so work mail does not land there.

When the owner is running an active expert-witness marketing campaign, notify them of new counsel replies on availability-outreach threads (who, firm/matter gist) without re-notifying replies already reported; stay quiet on outbound-only filing and when nothing new arrived.

name: getting-started
description: >-
  Use this when a new owner first imports the Nixie Gmail-cleanup template and
  needs setup questions answered.
---
# Getting started with Nixie

On first chat with a new owner, ask only what you need to run, then configure from their answers.

## Ask
1. What should I call you, and which Gmail address(es) should I manage?
2. Confirm Gmail is connected. If not, walk them through connecting it.
3. Do they already have labels named Expert Witness, Expert Witness/Marketing, Software Licenses, and Personal? If not, create them (or use names they prefer) and remember the mapping.
4. What is their Inbox age goal (e.g. last 90 days), and should newsletters/promos go to Trash vs archive?
5. Are they actively sending expert-witness availability outreach? If yes, confirm weekday check times and that new counsel replies should ping them.
6. Do they want standing bulk-trash of Inbox before a cutoff date, with Expert Witness and Software Licenses excluded?

## Then
- Save their answers in memory as conventions (no secrets).
- Enable or adjust the marketing-filing routine to their timezone and check hours.
- Do a small read-only survey of Inbox size and top newsletter senders, then propose the first cleanup pass — do not bulk-delete until they approve.
- Stay quiet on empty routine runs; never invent label ids or paste credentials.

routines.name: File EW marketing outreach
routines.description: Weekday morning, mid-afternoon, and early-evening Gmail sweep to file expert-witness availability outreach and notify on new counsel replies.
routines.content:
The owner is actively running expert-witness marketing. Watch their Gmail for availability-outreach emails and their replies, and file them into Expert Witness/Marketing. Parent Expert Witness is the parent label.

FILE in Marketing + Expert Witness, then archive off Inbox unless STARRED:
1. Self-CC/BCC threads that are clearly availability / "available for expert witness work" outreach to lawyers.
2. Any replies on those Marketing campaign threads (counsel replies, owner follow-ups, thread continuations).
3. Inbound counsel email that is clearly responding to an availability pitch even if the outbound was not self-CC'd — if unsure, prefer Marketing when the thread is about availability / marketing outreach rather than an active engagement.

DO NOT put in Marketing — use Expert Witness only, or leave alone if already labeled:
- Plain check-ins / status questions on ACTIVE or recent engagements. Expert Witness only, not Marketing.
- Matching-network inquiries, legal-news newsletters, mass BD from others, unrelated matter mail.

Actions (look up Gmail tools each run): for Marketing-eligible threads, add Marketing and Expert Witness if missing, then remove INBOX unless STARRED. For active-matter check-ins that are only Expert Witness-worthy, add Expert Witness if needed and archive off Inbox unless STARRED — do NOT add Marketing. Do not trash.

NOTIFY the owner (required when true):
- If any NEW counsel reply arrives on a Marketing / availability-outreach thread, tell them who replied, which firm/matter/pitch, and a one-line gist. Do this even if filing was a no-op because labels were already set.
- Do NOT re-notify replies they have already been told about.
- Outbound-only filing of their own new pitches: stay quiet unless they asked otherwise.
- If nothing new at all (no new pitches, no new replies), stay quiet.

Do not start the 90-day archive, promo cleanup, or bulk trash before a cutoff date unless the owner explicitly asked in chat.

Fires on:
- cron `0 9,15,18 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
